input.goal: Create a single self-contained index.html: an interactive full-viewport HTML5 Canvas orbital particle simulation in dark space (background #060913), with a central glowing star, orbiting planets with moons and fading trails, a twinkling starfield, a glassmorphism HUD (Play/Pause, Trails ON/OFF, Reset, speed slider, FPS/time/particle readouts), and click-to-spawn radial particle bursts. Zero external dependencies.
constraints: Single file index.html with inline <style> and <script>; no external URLs, fonts, images or libraries.
Page background and canvas clear color #060913; body margin 0, overflow hidden.
One full-window <canvas id="sim"> resized on window resize; backing store width/height = CSS size * window.devicePixelRatio and context scaled with setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0).
Animation loop uses requestAnimationFrame with delta time in seconds (clamp dt to max 0.05).
Central star at canvas center drawn with ctx.createRadialGradient (white/yellow core to transparent orange glow) plus a corona whose radius pulses subtly with Math.sin over time.

At least 5 planets in window.app.planets, each object with fields: name, radius (orbit radius, all distinct), speed (angular speed, all distinct), color (all distinct hex colors), size, angle, trail (array of recent {x,y} points).
At least 3 moons total in window.app.moons, each with fields: parent (planet index), radius, speed, color, size, angle; moons orbit their parent planet.

Orbital trails: each planet keeps up to ~80 recent positions and draws them as a polyline/dots whose alpha fades from 0 at the oldest to ~0.6 at the newest. Trails drawn only when app.trails is true; also draw faint thin orbit circles.
Starfield: window.app.stars array with at least 150 stars, each with x, y, r, phase, twinkle speed; alpha varies with Math.sin(time*speed+phase).

window.app object exposes: running (bool, default true), trails (bool, default true), speed (number, default 1.0), simTime (seconds, number), fps (number), particles (array of burst particles), planets, moons, stars, and functions togglePlay(), toggleTrails(), reset(), spawnBurst(x,y).
simTime advances by dt*app.speed only while app.running; planet/moon angles advance by speed*dt*app.speed only while running. When paused, planets do not move.

HUD: a fixed-position panel top-left with glassmorphism styling: background rgba(255,255,255,0.08), backdrop-filter: blur(12px) (and -webkit-backdrop-filter), border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18), border-radius 14px, light text color #e6ecff, system-ui font.
HUD button id="playBtn": text "Pause" while running, "Play" while paused; click calls app.togglePlay().
HUD button id="trailsBtn": text "Trails: ON" when trails on, "Trails: OFF" when off; click calls app.toggleTrails(). Turning trails off also clears all planet trail arrays.

HUD button id="resetBtn" text "Reset": app.reset() sets simTime to 0, restores initial planet/moon angles, clears trails and empties app.particles, sets speed back to 1.0 and slider value to 1.0, running to true.

Speed slider exactly: <input type="range" id="speed" min="0.2" max="3.0" step="0.1" value="1.0">; on input event sets app.speed = parseFloat(value) and updates <span id="speedVal"> to the multiplier formatted like "1.0x" (value.toFixed(1)+'x').

Live readouts updated each frame (or every ~250ms for FPS): <span id="fps"> integer FPS, <span id="time"> simTime with toFixed(1) followed by " s", <span id="count"> = app.particles.length. Labels in the HUD: "FPS", "Time", "Particles", "Speed".

Clicking the canvas (mousedown/click on #sim, using clientX/clientY in CSS pixels) calls app.spawnBurst(x,y) which pushes 60-100 particles with random angle, random speed 80-320 px/s, life 1.0-2.0 s, random warm/cool hue; particles move with velocity damping (v *= Math.pow(0.9, dt*60) or similar), alpha fades with remaining life, drawn as glowing circles using globalCompositeOperation 'lighter'; dead particles are removed from app.particles.
Particles keep updating/fading even if paused is NOT required; but they must update while running. Clicks on HUD must not spawn bursts (HUD is outside the canvas element events / stopPropagation).
Valid JavaScript, no console errors.

content.text:
Tandem wrote `index.html` and its browser test passed on the first try. It's one file with no external dependencies: a starfield of at least 150 twinkling stars, a glowing central star with a pulsing corona, at least 5 planets and at least 3 moons with fading trails, and a glass-style control panel. Clicking the canvas sets off a burst of particles that slows down and fades out.

The test drove the page in a real browser: Play/Pause, Trails, Reset, the speed slider with its "2.5x" readout, a particle burst, and the particle counter all behaved correctly. I haven't opened the file or reviewed the code myself. The FPS and simulation-time readouts and the look of the page weren't asserted by the test, so open `index.html` in a browser to see it.
